articles.summary: HOUSTON, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Archrock, Inc. (NYSE: AROC) (“Archrock” or the “Company”) today reported results for the third quarter 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was $370.8 million compared to $382.4 million in the third quarter of 2025. Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $84.5 million and EPS was $0.48 compared to $71.2 million and $0.40, respectively, in the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income (a non-GAAP measure defined below) for the third quarter of 2026 was $84.7 million and adjusted EPS (a non-GAAP measure defined below) was $0.49, compared to $73.2 million and $0.42, respectively, in the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted EBITDA (a non-GAAP measure defined below) for the third quarter of 2026 was $228.4 million compared to $220.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. Declared a quarterly dividend of $0.23 per common share for the third quarter of 2026, approximately 10% higher compared to the third quarter
articles.title: Archrock Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
